checks.detail: vitverk is the requested repository owner, not a verified legal/developer identity. Confirm the intended publisher in each portal.

Confirm whether this demo involves payments or purchases and declare review.commerce.
Provide a working publisher/support contact through secure portal fields; GitHub Issues is available for package support.
Record and host real interactions in a target chat host; submission/demo-walkthrough.md provides the script. A script is not a recording.
Capture 3–5 PNGs >=1000px wide from actual Claude MCP App responses and provide prompts separately. Standalone browser screenshots cannot prove Claude host behavior.
Run five positive and three negative cases in ChatGPT and Claude against this package. Direct MCP smoke is separate evidence.
